title: Androidaps skips over latest xdrip measurement
body:
AndroidAps is getting bg values from xdrip broadcast 
Xdrip provides value each 5 minutes 

On AndroidAps you can see latest value when xdrip gets latest value, this latest value is displayed for a short moment but will be ignored with previous value

Attached version Infos of androidaps / xdrip
Displayed bg and received xdrip values
